PLUGIN_HOSTD_LV2_MAP.doc: How an LV2 plugin's field dump (omx-clap-scan --fields) becomes a scanned descriptor, and, read backwards, what a generator writes an LV2 .ttl from: every LV2 term and the RDF and DOAP predicates a scan reads, each mapped to a descriptor word, carried in the extension bag or dropped by its ruling (docs/formats.md).
